invariants.rationale: The method iterates over layers, so if non-null, it must be iterable/array.
Array size must be non-negative and fileHandles is never set to null.
tmjFile is always passed recursively, never set to null in this method.
The code assumes the presence of a 'type' key for each element in layers.
fileHandles can only grow or stay the same, never negative, even if layers == null.
